import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='petal_length',
    y='petal_width',
    hue='species',
    s=100, # Marker size
    alpha=0.8, # Transparency
    palette='viridis' # Color palette
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Iris Petal Measurements by Species', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='10', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# Improve layout and save the figure
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.88, 1]) # Adjust layout to prevent legend from being cut off
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
